steps.title: Builds on your PC
steps.body: Chats can now run a command on one of your worker PCs: a release build, a render, anything too heavy for the server. The code comes from GitHub at the server's commit, or as a copy of the project with your unsaved changes; the output streams into the chat and the files it made come back. It runs at low priority, keeps build caches between runs, and carries on if the connection drops.
